question: Can a user tune and preserve the winter street appearance without the per-adjustment CI loop?
hypothesis: A direct interface to production appearance uniforms/materials with a fixed pose and explicit approved preset gives immediate feedback while preventing metrics from silently replacing the user's accepted look.

conditions.reference: user-provided game-engine-winter-promo-1080p.mp4; current renderer equivalence not claimed
conditions.authority: The user chooses visual appearance. Stanford checks controlled renderer correctness; performance checks measure cost. Neither authorizes a new appearance baseline.
conditions.usegitContext: Pinned npx context command attempted before edits; blocked by container DNS EAI_AGAIN. AGENTS, open PR metadata, source and existing authority experiment were read through GitHub connector. No work lease was claimed or replaced.

acceptance: Appearance edits change the actual GPU canvas without changing simulation time/camera or submitting CI.
Approval requires an explicit user action and preserves a PNG, full appearance preset, camera, time, resolution and engine revision.
A/B refuses mismatched views; imported data is validated; project-subpath asset URLs resolve.
User manually approves the resulting appearance. Automated smoke does not count as that approval.
evidence: 7 local Node tests passed; module syntax checks passed. Real GPU integration and Pages deployment pending.
decision: Replace the CI appearance-search loop with a human-controlled live tool; retain independent correctness/performance checks. No claim of restored promo quality until user review.
